color.note: Two themes mirror the tagline: Day (near-white ground, white cards, deep-teal ink) and Night (deep-lagoon ground, foam ink). Brand hues are fixed across themes; semantic tokens swap. Text pairs are checked to WCAG 2.1 AA in both themes. Blog extension adds brand-ocean, surface-sand and four category tones (lagoon, coral, sand, ocean). Dashboard extension adds chart-1…6 (validated categorical order), chart-grid and chart-other. Calendar extension adds shift-day and shift-night bands for VA schedules.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: The wordmark ink from the logo. Primary text in Day; hero bands and footer ground. Never as text in Night (use ink).

tokens.name: brand-lagoon
tokens.usage: The left arc (trust, calm). Decorative fills, illustration, chart series 1, selected-row tint at 16% alpha. Never as text on sand or white (1.7:1).

tokens.name: brand-reef
tokens.usage: The moon. Icons and large display accents (3:1 on white). Not for body text in Day.

tokens.name: brand-sunrise
tokens.usage: The right arc (energy, warmth). Primary CTA fill with brand-deep text (7.1:1). Never as text on light grounds.

tokens.name: brand-sun
tokens.usage: The sun dot. Small highlights: notification dot, 'live' indicator, illustration. Max one per view.

tokens.name: brand-palm
tokens.usage: Palm leaves. Illustration and imagery accents only; status success has its own token.

tokens.name: brand-ocean
tokens.usage: Open-water blue — the blog's fourth tropical hue. Wave layers, illustration, chart series 4. Holds 5.4:1 on white, so it may carry text in Day; use action-ocean for buttons.

tokens.name: brand-sand
tokens.usage: The logo ground. Warm accent bands on marketing pages (testimonials, footer CTA) and text on brand-deep bands. Not a page or card background.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background. Day is near-white with a faint lagoon cast; Night is deep lagoon.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, modals, nav bar, inputs, dashboard panels.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, table header rows, dashboard sidebar, code blocks.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltips, footer band, toast background.

tokens.name: surface-sand
tokens.usage: Warm beach band for blog CTA bands and newsletter panels. ink (10.2:1 Day, 13:1 Night), ink-muted and ink-accent all pass on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on surface-page, surface-card, surface-sunken (≥9.4:1 Day, ≥12:1 Night).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, captions, placeholders on surface-page, surface-card, surface-sunken (≥5.4:1 Day, ≥6.3:1 Night).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse and brand-deep bands.

tokens.name: ink-accent
tokens.usage: Warm accent text: eyebrows, 'New' labels, small emphasis on surface-page and surface-card (≥5.5:1 Day, ≥6.2:1 Night).

tokens.name: ink-on-deep-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on brand-deep bands (featured post banner, footer): excerpts, meta (7.8:1). Titles on brand-deep use brand-sand (10.2:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines where shape is also shown by fill. Not for control boundaries.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select, checkbox and toggle-track outlines; must hold 3:1 on surface-card and surface-page.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. One per view: the main conversion (Book a call, Hire a VA).

tokens.name: action-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: action-primary-active
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed.

tokens.name: on-action-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on action-primary and its hover/active fills (≥4.9:1).

tokens.name: action-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill; links; selected states; checkbox and toggle 'on'.

tokens.name: action-secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary hover; link hover.

tokens.name: on-action-secondary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on action-secondary (6.1:1 Day, 9.7:1 Night).

tokens.name: action-ghost-hover
tokens.usage: Ghost button and nav-link hover wash.

tokens.name: action-ocean
tokens.usage: Ocean button fill for supporting blog CTAs (Subscribe, Join the newsletter) so they never compete with the single sunrise primary.

tokens.name: action-ocean-hover
tokens.usage: Ocean button hover.

tokens.name: on-action-ocean
tokens.usage: Label on action-ocean and its hover (5.4:1 Day, 9.1:1 Night).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on surface-page and surface-card; underline always on body copy.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid outline at 2px offset on every focusable element (≥4.6:1 Day, ≥8:1 Night on all surfaces).

tokens.name: disabled-fill
tokens.usage: Disabled control fill. Disabled text is exempt from contrast but stays readable.

tokens.name: disabled-ink
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons on disabled-fill.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Success text/icon on surface-card and status-success-bg. Always with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: status-success-bg
tokens.usage: Success banner and badge fill.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning text/icon. Always with an alert icon and a word.

tokens.name: status-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning banner and badge fill.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Error text, invalid input border, destructive buttons. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: status-danger-bg
tokens.usage: Error banner and badge fill.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Info text/icon.

tokens.name: status-info-bg
tokens.usage: Info banner and badge fill.

tokens.name: tag-lagoon-bg
tokens.usage: Blog category tone 'lagoon' (calm topics — remote work, how-tos): tag chip, avatar and cover-sky fill.

tokens.name: tag-lagoon-ink
tokens.usage: Text, dot and selected-chip fill for tone 'lagoon'. ≥5.7:1 on tag-lagoon-bg and ≥6.7:1 against surface-card in both themes.

tokens.name: tag-coral-bg
tokens.usage: Blog category tone 'coral' (people topics — client stories, team spotlights): tag chip, avatar and cover-sky fill.

tokens.name: tag-coral-ink
tokens.usage: Text, dot and selected-chip fill for tone 'coral'. ≥5.7:1 on tag-coral-bg and ≥6.7:1 against surface-card in both themes.

tokens.name: tag-sand-bg
tokens.usage: Blog category tone 'sand' (culture topics — agency life, behind the scenes): tag chip, avatar and cover-sky fill.

tokens.name: tag-sand-ink
tokens.usage: Text, dot and selected-chip fill for tone 'sand'. ≥5.7:1 on tag-sand-bg and ≥6.7:1 against surface-card in both themes.

tokens.name: tag-ocean-bg
tokens.usage: Blog category tone 'ocean' (work topics — productivity, tools, guides): tag chip, avatar and cover-sky fill.

tokens.name: tag-ocean-ink
tokens.usage: Text, dot and selected-chip fill for tone 'ocean'. ≥5.7:1 on tag-ocean-bg and ≥6.7:1 against surface-card in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal and mobile-drawer backdrop.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (teal). Assign in order 1→6, never cycled; a 7th series folds into 'Other'. Validated: adjacent CVD ΔE ≥13 Day / ≥14.6 Night, ≥3:1 on surface-card. Marks only — labels stay in ink tokens.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (orange). Assign in order 1→6, never cycled; a 7th series folds into 'Other'. Validated: adjacent CVD ΔE ≥13 Day / ≥14.6 Night, ≥3:1 on surface-card. Marks only — labels stay in ink tokens.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (ocean). Assign in order 1→6, never cycled; a 7th series folds into 'Other'. Validated: adjacent CVD ΔE ≥13 Day / ≥14.6 Night, ≥3:1 on surface-card. Marks only — labels stay in ink tokens.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (green). Assign in order 1→6, never cycled; a 7th series folds into 'Other'. Validated: adjacent CVD ΔE ≥13 Day / ≥14.6 Night, ≥3:1 on surface-card. Marks only — labels stay in ink tokens.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (violet). Assign in order 1→6, never cycled; a 7th series folds into 'Other'. Validated: adjacent CVD ΔE ≥13 Day / ≥14.6 Night, ≥3:1 on surface-card. Marks only — labels stay in ink tokens.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6 (rose). Assign in order 1→6, never cycled; a 7th series folds into 'Other'. Validated: adjacent CVD ΔE ≥13 Day / ≥14.6 Night, ≥3:1 on surface-card. Marks only — labels stay in ink tokens.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines and baseline ticks inside charts; recessive by design.

tokens.name: chart-other
tokens.usage: The folded 'Other' series and inactive/filtered-out marks (3.6:1 Day, 4:1 Night on surface-card).

tokens.name: shift-day-bg
tokens.usage: Day-shift band behind schedule hours (ScheduleCalendar). A faint wash only — events sit on top; ink passes 12:1 Day, 14:1 Night.

tokens.name: shift-day-ink
tokens.usage: Day-shift label and sun icon on shift-day-bg (6.4:1 Day, 10.4:1 Night).

tokens.name: shift-night-bg
tokens.usage: Night-shift band behind schedule hours. ink passes 11:1 Day, 13.4:1 Night.

tokens.name: shift-night-ink
tokens.usage: Night-shift label and moon icon on shift-night-bg (6.6:1 Day, 9:1 Night).

styles.name: display-lg

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title, one per page. Fluid: clamp(1.875rem, 1.6rem + 1.1vw, 2.25rem).

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: A dedicated assistant who knows your business.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We cover inbox, scheduling and customer replies around the clock.
styles.usage: Default text. Never below 16px for long-form or input values (prevents iOS zoom).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary detail, table cells, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button labels (sm/md), tabs, nav links.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, badges, chart axis labels. Never for essential instructions.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above headings — echoes the logo tagline. Set text-transform: uppercase in CSS; write the source text in sentence case for screen readers.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Invoice and ticket IDs, API keys (masked), code samples.

spacing.note: 4px base. Use the scale only; no in-between values.

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.name: space-5

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-10

tokens.name: space-16

tokens.usage: Checkboxes, badges, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md

tokens.name: radius-xl
